name: Basic Bread Dough
author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors

ingredients.item: Warm water (heated for about 40 seconds in the microwave)

steps: Add ingredients to a 2-pound capacity bread machine in the order listed, select dough cycle, and press start.
When dough is finished, form into desired shape on a floured surface, and place on baking sheet or pizza stone.
Bake until lightly brown and firm. Cooking time will vary with altitude (20–40 minutes).
